subject: NovaBank: MAP checklist & compliance gating for evaluation
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@novabank.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Sharma <r.sharma@novabank.com>, procurement@novabank.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps for Redwood eval

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team found the latency numbers compelling. Before we move to a PoC or procurement, our InfoSec and Legal teams need a clear Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lists the compliance gates and approximate time-to-close for each. High level asks from Security: SOC 2 Type II evidence, completed SIG/CAIQ, the DPA (we usually redline), and a short note on data retention and logging.

Could you share a draft MAP that maps these items to owners, required artifacts, and target dates? Also include who at Redwood will be the point for SOC 2 questions and for data processing terms.

Regards,
Emily
Emily Park
Director, Cloud Platform Risk
NovaBank

From: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@novabank.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps for Redwood eval

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a first-pass MAP (Novabank_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks out compliance gates, owners, evidence, and suggested timelines. Quick highlights from our side:  

- SOC 2 Type II: we can provide the latest report (attached stub) and arrange a Q&A with our Security lead (Laura). Target: 2 weeks to confirm artifacts, 1–2 weeks for any follow-ups.
- SIG/CAIQ: we completed a CAIQ baseline internally; I attached a SIG answer workbook with top-level responses. Target: 10 business days for completed responses and follow-up clarifications.
- DPA: we shared a redline of your standard DPA in the doc (DPA_redline_v3.docx). Legal can review + negotiate; expect 2–4 weeks depending on scope.
- Data retention & logging: short summary included in the MAP sheet — default retention for request logs is 90 days, KV cache artifacts 30 days by default (can be configured), audit logs retained for 365 days in our customer tenancy. We call out options for custom retention via our Private deployment.

Next steps: can we lock a review call next week with Security + Legal? Laura, Sean — can you join to handle SOC 2 + SIG questions?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@novabank.com>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaBank MAP checklist & compliance gating for evaluation

Emily — adding a couple of practical notes from Security/Controls perspective:  

1) SOC 2: we will provide the Type II report and a short controls summary (encryption at rest/in transit, key management, access reviews). If NovaBank needs a narrow scoping (e.g., excluding some infra shared services), flag that on the call and we can map evidence.

2) SIG/CAIQ: we will pre-populate high-risk sections (network, isolation, key management) and leave a comments column for you to request deeper evidence.

3) DPA: Legal prefers redline first; we typically accept standard commercial exceptions but will escalate anything that looks like broad indemnities.

4) Timeline: realistic cadence we propose in the MAP is 3–5 calendar weeks to get to an evidence-complete state (not counting legal negotiations). If NovaBank requests a private deployment or dedicated capacity for additional isolation controls, add ~2–3 weeks for infra prep.

I attached the SOC2_TypeII_Report_stub.pdf (redacted stub) and the SIG_CAICQ_answers.xlsx in case that speeds review.

—Sean
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference

From: Rajesh Sharma <r.sharma@novabank.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@novabank.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaBank MAP checklist & compliance gating for evaluation

Priya / Emily — quick procurement note: for internal ordering we need a clear acceptance criteria column on the MAP so our Sourcing team can tick off items during the supplier security review. Also we prefer the DPA negotiation to identify any non-negotiables up front (e.g., data residency, subprocessor list cadence). Can Redwood flag those in the MAP?

From our side: we require logs retention of 2 years for audit trail related to regulated accounts; will you be able to extend audit log retention beyond the default 365 days? If not, what are the options for exporting logs to our archive?

- Rajesh
Head of Sourcing, NovaBank

From: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@novabank.com>, Rajesh Sharma <r.sharma@novabank.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaBank MAP checklist & compliance gating for evaluation

Thanks Rajesh — good call. Updated plan below and attached version v1.1 on Drive (link included). Short answers here so Sourcing can move: 

- Acceptance criteria: added a dedicated column in the MAP for "evidence to close" (e.g., SOC 2 report + control mapping; SIG answers + supporting screenshots; signed DPA).
- DPA non-negotiables: we flagged data residency & subprocessors as items that may require escalation; we listed Redwood's standard subprocessors and cadence for updates in the MAP 
- Audit log retention: by default we retain audit logs 365 days in our managed offering. For NovaBank regulated accounts we can: 
   * Option A: Extend retention to 730 days (2 years) for Dedicated or Private deployments (requires configuration and a small storage surcharge) — target timeline: 2–3 weeks to enable and verify.
   * Option B: Weekly export to an S3 bucket owned by NovaBank (encrypted) with lifecycle rules for long-term archival — target timeline: 1 week to configure and test.

Next step: propose a 45-minute call on Sep 17 to run through the updated MAP and to confirm which retention option NovaBank prefers so we can reflect it in costs. Docusign envelope for the DPA redline will be ready if Legal confirms preferred edits.

Attachments: Novabank_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (drive link), DPA_redline_v3.docx, SOC2_TypeII_Report_stub.pdf

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
